citations.title: Industry - SLB completes acquisition of ChampionX

sentences.text: SLB completed its roughly $7.8 billion all-stock acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025, adding production chemicals plus artificial lift, digital and emissions technologies that extend asset life along the production lifecycle.
Management expects about $400 million of annual pretax synergies within the first three years after closing, through revenue growth and cost savings.

sentences.quote: This move expands SLB's presence in this important, less cyclical, and growing market that aligns closely with our returns-focused, capital-light core growth strategy.
sentences.text: The deal targets a less cyclical, growing production market aligned with a returns-focused, capital-light growth strategy.
Digital is now reported as a standalone division, and excluding ChampionX, full-year 2025 Digital revenue rose 7% year on year while total revenue fell 6%.

Fourth-quarter 2025 revenue of $9.7 billion rose 9% sequentially, with all four geographic areas up sequentially for the first time since the second quarter of 2024 as global upstream markets stabilized.
SLB also guided to returning $4 billion to shareholders in 2025.
